title: FC300 — Black Fictional Characters Registry
description: 300 Black fictional characters across seven mediums (Television 70, Film 60, Comics & Superheroes 50, Animation 40, Literature & Books 40, Video Games 25, Theater & Stage 15), each with creator, first appearance, portrayer, coverage status, citation, and a full AEO layer. Only 139 characters have a Wikidata item of their own; 157 (52%) exist solely inside their franchise's page. Coverage Status is the dataset's evidence vocabulary, kept verbatim. Images are link-only by design — the dataset distributes metadata and citations, never image files.
notes: Pre-publication package (v1.0 assembled 2026-11-16 from the canonical 2026-11-04 file). Zenodo deposit pending the founder's token sitting; no DOI yet.
